activeRecallQuiz.scenario: A stock hits a 52-week new high, but daily volume is 50% below average and OBV fails to break its prior high. What does this signal?
activeRecallQuiz.question: A stock hits a 52-week new high, but daily volume is 50% below average and OBV fails to break its prior high. What does this signal?
activeRecallQuiz.correctAnswer: Bearish Divergence / Bull Trap: Lack of institutional volume indicates exhaustion and warns that the breakout will likely fail.
activeRecallQuiz.explanation: Applying grounded principles prevents catastrophic losses and capital depletion.

coreTakeaways: Always evaluate underlying market assumptions before entering positions.
Separate gross theoretical payoff from real-world net profit.
Follow disciplined risk and position sizing limits on every trade.
